# Why Culinary Academy is Rated the Best Culinary Institute in Dhaka (2026 Update)

Choosing the right training ground is the most significant decision a future chef will make. In a city bustling with options, one institution consistently rises to the top. This guide explores why industry experts and students alike rate [Culinary Academy](/en/about) as the **Best culinary Institute in Dhaka**. From our elite mentorship to our global placement records, we set the benchmark for culinary excellence.

## 1. Commercial-Grade Facilities vs. Traditional Classrooms

Most culinary schools in Dhaka operate out of small, domestic-style kitchens. However, the professional world does not work on home stoves. To be the **Best culinary Institute in Dhaka**, Culinary Academy invested in a 2,000 sq. ft. commercial-grade kitchen laboratory. 

Our facility features:
- **Industrial Convection Ovens**: Learning to manage heat at scale.
- **High-Pressure Burners**: Mastering the speed of a 5-star kitchen.
- **Individual Workstations**: Every student has their own space to practice, ensuring no one is left behind.

This immersion in a professional environment is what prepares our students for [high-paying chef jobs](/en/blog/executive-chef-salary-bangladesh-guide) immediately after graduation.

## 2. Mentorship by Industry Legends

An institution is only as good as its instructors. At Culinary Academy, we don't have 'teachers'; we have mentors. Our faculty is led by **Dewan Ismail** and **Rafeya Chowdhury**, veterans with decades of experience in global luxury hospitality. 

Unlike traditional academic settings, our mentors provide direct, hands-on feedback. They share the 'mental models' and 'industrial discipline' that can only be learned in the heat of a real service. You can read more about their backgrounds on our [Expert Culinary Mentors](/en/expert-culinary-mentors) page.

## 3. Global Affiliations and Certifications

In 2026, a local certificate is often not enough for a global career. Culinary Academy's status as the **Best culinary Institute in Dhaka** is cemented by our international affiliations. Our programs are mapped to **NSDA & ISO-HACCP certifications** and are fully approved by the **National Skills Development Authority (NSDA)** under the Prime Minister's Office.

We are also an **ISO-HACCP** compliant institution, ensuring that our food safety training meets the highest global standards. This level of accreditation is why our graduates are working in 16+ countries today.

## 4. The 'Skills Over Degrees' Philosophy

At Culinary Academy, our mantra is simple: 'Degrees hang on walls, but skills put money in your pocket.' We prioritize 100% practical training over long theoretical lectures. Every module is designed to solve a real-world culinary problem, from knife mastery to [food costing and profitability](/en/blog/restaurant-food-costing-formula-profitability).

Our [Professional Chef Courses](/en/courses) are structured to deliver maximum skill acquisition in the shortest time possible, making them the preferred choice for career shifters and ambitious students.

## 5. Unrivaled Job Placement Records

The ultimate proof of an institute's quality is where its students end up. Culinary Academy provides [conditional placement support](/en/admission) at leading 5-star hotels like Radisson Blu, InterContinental, and Pan Pacific Sonargaon. Our alumni network is our greatest pride, with graduates dominating the culinary landscape both locally and internationally.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What makes Culinary Academy different from other culinary schools in Dhaka?
CIB is the only institute in Dhaka that combines a 2,000 sq. ft. commercial-grade kitchen with international NSDA certifications and mentorship from 5-star industry veterans like Dewan Ismail. Our focus is 100% on practical, industry-ready skills.

### Are the courses at Culinary Academy recognized internationally?
Yes. Our curriculum is mapped to international standards, and we offer NSDA-approved certifications that are recognized by hospitality employers in the Middle East, Europe, and beyond.

### How much does it cost to enroll in Culinary Academy?
While costs vary by program, Culinary Academy is committed to providing elite-level training at a value that ensures a high ROI. We offer various [admission packages](/en/admission) designed to suit different career goals, from basic skills to advanced management.

### Can I visit the campus before enrolling?
Absolutely. We encourage all prospective students to visit our Dhanmondi campus to see our commercial kitchen facility and meet our [mentors](/en/expert-culinary-mentors) in person. This transparency is part of why we are rated the best.

### Do you offer weekend or evening classes for working professionals?
Yes. Culinary Academy understands that many of our students are career shifters. We offer flexible scheduling, including intensive weekend sessions, to ensure you can master the art of cooking without quitting your current job.
